whatChanged.headline: Block Says Its Voice AI Learned Without Text. What Did It Learn?
whatChanged.headlineZh: Block 称 AI 只靠听人说话学会聊天。它究竟学会了什么？
intro: When someone says “I'm fine,” the words alone don't tell you whether they're cheerful, annoyed or close to tears. Block's research lab is trying a different way to build voice AI: teach a model from recorded conversations, without first turning speech into text.

On October 23, Block introduced Dessa, a speech-to-speech research model. In the company's demonstrations, it interrupts, laughs mid-conversation and responds with different tones of voice. Those are demonstrations, not yet independently established performance results.
introZh: 有人说“我没事”，光看这三个字，很难判断对方是在开心、赌气，还是快哭了。Block 的研究团队尝试换一种方法训练语音 AI：让模型直接听人类对话，不先把声音变成文字。
2026 年 10 月 23 日，Block 公布了语音研究模型 Dessa。公司展示的对话里，它会插话、在说话途中笑出声，也会改变语气。不过，这些还是公司提供的演示，并非已经得到独立验证的性能结论。

sections.heading: How does a model learn without reading?
sections.headingZh: 不看文字，AI 怎么学会聊天？
paragraphs: Block says Dessa was trained from scratch on recordings of human conversation, with no text data and no pretrained models. It takes speech as input and produces speech directly. The aim is to preserve information a transcript can lose: pauses, emphasis, timing and changes in tone. A sentence can mean something quite different depending on which word the speaker stresses.

The team calls Dessa “full-duplex.” That means it can listen while talking, rather than waiting for one person to finish every sentence. In the published clips, it sometimes reacts with a laugh or a short acknowledgment before the speaker has finished.
paragraphsZh: Block 表示，Dessa 从零开始训练，学习材料只有人类对话录音，没有文字数据，也没有使用预训练模型。它直接接收声音、生成声音，试图保留转写成文字时容易丢失的信息：停顿、重音、说话节奏和语气变化。同一句话，强调不同的词，意思就可能不同。
团队把 Dessa 称为“全双工”语音模型，意思是它能边听边说，不必每次都等对方把一句话说完。公司公布的片段里，它有时会在对方说话途中笑出来，或用简短的回应表示自己在听。

sections.heading: Does it need a huge data centre to talk?
sections.headingZh: 这样的 AI 需要大型数据中心才能运行吗？
paragraphs: Block says it trained Dessa using one NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 system—a rack-scale machine, not one ordinary graphics card. The company also says the finished model can run locally on a MacBook Pro with an M4 Max chip or better. Training hardware and the hardware needed to run a trained model are two different things.

That local-running claim is interesting because it points to voice interfaces that may not need to send every exchange to a remote server. But Block has not publicly demonstrated a consumer product or published the independent tests needed to judge cost, reliability or privacy in real-world use.
paragraphsZh: Block 称，训练 Dessa 使用了一套 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 系统。这是一整套机架级设备，不能理解成一张普通显卡。公司还表示，训练完成的模型可以在配备 M4 Max 芯片或更高配置的 MacBook Pro 上本地运行。训练模型需要的硬件，与日常运行模型的硬件，是两回事。
如果本地运行能真正普及，语音助手就未必每次都要把对话送到远端服务器。但目前 Block 没有推出可供大众使用的产品，也没有公开足够的独立测试，让外界判断它在真实环境里的成本、稳定性和隐私表现。

sections.heading: Can people try it now?
sections.headingZh: 现在能用到 Dessa 吗？
paragraphs: Not yet for the general public. Block is inviting a small group of AI safety researchers to request early access, but there is no public model to test. The Verge also noted awkward moments and off-topic replies in the released clips.
The bigger question is whether sounding sensitive to emotion means the system reliably understands it. Dessa's recordings make that worth investigating; they do not settle it.
paragraphsZh: 普通用户目前还不能试用。Block 邀请少量 AI 安全研究人员联系申请提前体验，但尚未开放公众使用渠道。The Verge 听过演示后也指出，有些对话仍然尴尬，甚至会突然跑题。
还有一个值得继续观察的问题：AI 能把情绪表现得很像人，是否就代表它真的能可靠地理解人的情绪？现有演示还不足以回答。

whatChanged.ending: A convincing voice is easy to notice; dependable understanding will be harder to prove.
whatChanged.endingZh: 声音像不像人，很容易听出来；它能否真正可靠地理解人，还需要更多证据。

stayCurious.categoryZh: 新加坡 / 天气 / 日常生活
stayCurious.headline: Singapore Has Lightning on 176 Days a Year. Why So Often?
stayCurious.headlineZh: 新加坡平均一年有 176 天出现闪电，为什么这么频繁？
intro: A sunny Singapore afternoon can turn into a thunderstorm quickly. Singapore's Meteorological Service says the Changi climate station records lightning on about 176 days a year—nearly every other day.
A “lightning day” means at least one detection at that station, not a strike in every neighbourhood.
introZh: 新加坡的晴朗午后，有时转眼就变成雷雨天。气象署数据显示，樟宜气候观测站平均一年约有 176 天记录到闪电，接近每两天就有一天。
这里的“闪电日”是指观测站当天至少探测到一次闪电，不代表全岛每个地区都发生闪电。

sections.heading: Why does Singapore get so many thunderstorms?
sections.headingZh: 为什么新加坡这么容易形成雷雨？
paragraphs: Singapore's equatorial sunshine heats the ground, sending warm, humid air upwards. As it cools, clouds can grow into towering cumulonimbus clouds that produce lightning.
The sea helps too. Land heats faster than water, so afternoon sea breezes move inland and converge with other winds, helping thunderstorms form.
paragraphsZh: 新加坡靠近赤道，阳光让地面升温，暖湿空气随之上升、冷却，形成云层。云层不断向上发展成高大的积雨云，就可能带来雷雨和闪电。
海风也很重要。陆地比海水升温快，午后海风向内陆流动，与其他气流汇合，容易形成雷雨云。

sections.heading: Why are April and November especially active?
sections.headingZh: 为什么 4 月和 11 月特别容易打雷？
paragraphs: Singapore's inter-monsoon periods fall around April–May and October–November. Lighter, variable winds favour afternoon storms. The Meteorological Service says lightning is typically most active in November, followed by April and May. Together, these months account for over half the year's lightning strokes.
The service separately reports about 167 thunderstorm days a year, a different measure from lightning days.
paragraphsZh: 新加坡的两段季风转换期大致在 4 月至 5 月、10 月至 11 月。此时风力较弱、风向多变，容易在午后形成局部雷雨。气象署指出，闪电活动通常以 11 月最多，其次是 4 月和 5 月；这些月份贡献了全年超过一半的闪电放电次数。
气象署还统计平均每年约 167 个“雷雨日”，与“闪电日”是不同指标。

sections.heading: Why can a lightning warning appear when it isn't raining?
sections.headingZh: 没下雨，为什么也会收到闪电警报？
paragraphs: Lightning can strike more than 10 km from a storm cloud, even when nearby skies seem clear.

In an August 2026 parliamentary reply, Singapore's Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment said myENV can alert users when cloud-to-ground lightning is detected, or thundery showers are forecast within two hours, inside a 6 km radius of a chosen location. It does not predict a strike at that exact spot.

If you hear thunder, seek shelter in a substantial building or enclosed vehicle—not under a tree or in a swimming pool. NEA advises waiting at least 30 minutes after the last thunder before resuming outdoor activities.
paragraphsZh: 雷雨云不在头顶，也可能有危险。气象署指出，闪电有时可以落在距离雷雨云超过 10 公里的地方。
新加坡永续发展与环境部在 2026 年 8 月的国会答复中说明，如果用户选定位置周围 6 公里内探测到云对地闪电，或预报未来两小时会有雷阵雨，myENV 就可能发出提醒。这不代表闪电一定会击中该地点。
听到雷声，应进入稳固建筑物或封闭车辆，不要躲在树下或留在泳池里。国家环境局建议最后一次听到雷声后至少等待 30 分钟，再恢复户外活动。

stayCurious.ending: In Singapore, the most useful weather question is sometimes not “Will it rain here?” but “Is there lightning nearby?”
stayCurious.endingZh: 在新加坡，有时比“这里会不会下雨”更值得先问的是：“附近有没有闪电？”
